name: 07-collect-oaks-parcel
objective: Walk into the Viridian Mart. The clerk hands over OAK'S PARCEL on your first visit with no prerequisite at all — the mart's own default script runs it — so entering the shop is the whole of this leg.
evidence: watch:got_oaks_parcel!=0 — EVENT_GOT_OAKS_PARCEL, event index 57, wEventFlags $D74E bit 1. Set by ViridianMartOaksParcelScript beside the `GiveItem OAKS_PARCEL` that puts the parcel in the bag, so the flag and the bag cannot disagree.
